subject: economics

items.q: According to the law of demand, what happens as price rises?
items.why: Higher prices normally reduce quantity demanded (downward-sloping demand curve).

items.q: What does a change in a good's own price cause?
items.correct: A movement ALONG the demand curve.
items.misconception: A shift of the whole demand curve.
items.random_wrong: No effect on quantity at all.
items.why: Price changes move along the curve; non-price factors (income, tastes) shift it.

items.correct: Where quantity demanded equals quantity supplied.
items.misconception: Where supply is at its highest.
items.why: At equilibrium the market clears and the price is stable.
